description:
This trail is one of a few motorized routes/trails that lead into the Muskwa Ketchika Managment Area. Note that the routes have motorized weight restriction, under the Wildlife Act, contact the Ministry of Environment for information.

Northland Trailblazers Snowmobile Club

Moose ATV Club
directions: This trail is accessed by the Upper Halfway Road north of Fort St John. Drive 90 km on the Upper Halfway road, keep to the right (North) and drive to the end of the forestry road where the road crosses the next main river.
